{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of research and development expenses as reported in the income statement, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with rapidly increasing R&D expenses are more likely to experience future innovations and growth, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "calculate the change in inventory turnover over the past 2 years, using Compustat data and the formula: COGS / average inventory", "rationale": "an increase in inventory turnover indicates improving operational efficiency, which can lead to higher profitability and returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Index", "construction": "create an index based on the presence of certain corporate governance provisions, such as staggered boards, poison pills, and golden parachutes, using proxy statement data from Proxy Monitor", "rationale": "stronger corporate governance leads to better alignment of management and shareholder interests, resulting in higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 2-year growth rate of the number of employees, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with rapidly growing workforces are more likely to experience future growth and expansion, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Ratio", "construction": "calculate the ratio of advertising expenses to sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with high advertising expenses relative to sales may be investing in brand recognition and customer acquisition, leading to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "calculate the ratio of cost of goods sold to accounts payable, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with efficient supply chains are better able to manage their working capital and reduce costs, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Diversity", "construction": "calculate the Herfindahl index of geographic segment sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with diversified revenue streams across different geographic regions are less exposed to regional economic shocks, leading to more stable and higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Line Diversity", "construction": "calculate the Herfindahl index of product line sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "firms with diversified revenue streams across different product lines are less exposed to product-specific risks, leading to more stable and higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "calculate the number of years the current CEO has been in office, using data from proxy statements and company reports", "rationale": "CEOs with longer tenure may have more established relationships with employees, customers, and suppliers, leading to more effective management and higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Ownership Concentration", "construction": "calculate the Herfindahl index of institutional ownership, using data from CDA/Spectrum", "rationale": "firms with concentrated institutional ownership may experience more active monitoring and governance, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
